theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_lc_retraction_comparison
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U A : Set (Euclid P)) (T Z : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (π : Euclid P → Euclid P) (G G₃ L : ℝ), IsOpen U → IsMinimizingIn T A → T.support ⊆ A → 0 < G → G ≤ G₃ → closedBall (0 : Euclid P) G₃ ⊆ U → T.massOn (ball 0 G₃) ≠ ∞ → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 π (ball 0 (2 * G)) → MapsTo π (ball 0 (2 * G)) (A ∩ ball 0 G₃) → (∀ y ∈ A ∩ ball 0 (2 * G), π y = y) → (∀ y ∈ ball (0 : Euclid P) (2 * G), ‖fderiv ℝ π y‖ ≤ L) → IsIntegerMultiplicity Y → Y.boundary = 0 → IsCompact Y.support → Y.support ⊆ ball 0 G → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), Z ω = T ω + Y (testFormOnInclusion (subset_univ U) (m + 1) ω)) → (∀ (O : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → Euclid P) (c : ℝ), IsOpen O → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f O → (∀ y ∈ O, ‖fderiv ℝ f y‖ ≤ c) → ∃ push : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1) → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), (∀ (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), R.Represents X → IsCompact X.support → X.support ⊆ O → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), push X ω = ∫ x in R.carrier, (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x (((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) (f x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f x)) ∂μHE[m + 1]) ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity (push X) ∧ (push X).support ⊆ f '' X.support ∧ (push X).mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c ^ (m + 1)) * X.mass ∧ (X.boundary = 0 → (push X).boundary = 0) ∧ ((∀ y ∈ X.support, f y = y) → push X = X)) ∧ ∀ X₁ X₂ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity X₁ → IsIntegerMultiplicity X₂ → IsCompact X₁.support → X₁.support ⊆ O → IsCompact X₂.support → X₂.support ⊆ O → push (X₁ - X₂) = push X₁ - push X₂) → T.massOn (ball 0 G) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (L ^ (m + 1)) * Z.massOn (ball 0 G)
